content.introduction: The sources provide details on economic calendars and their features. Investing.com's Economic Calendar tracks significant economic events and data releases, marking high-impact events with three stars. TradingView's Economic Calendar shows upcoming events affecting assets and markets, customizable by region and timeframe. Tradingeconomics.com's Economic Calendar offers a comprehensive table with actual values, consensus figures, forecasts, and historical data for 196 countries and 300,000 indicators. Specific events on Tradingeconomics include Japan's Coincident Index Prel SEP at 118.8, Germany's Balance of Trade SEP at €19.5B, and South Africa's Foreign Exchange Reserves OCT at $75.43B.
body:
The Economic Calendar is a real-time, streaming schedule of economic events and data releases that can move financial markets. It tracks indicators such as GDP, inflation, employment figures, interest rate decisions, manufacturing PMI, consumer confidence, and central bank speeches from countries around the world.

### What do the star icons next to each event mean? [...] Our real-time Economic Calendar keeps track of all financial events and economic indicators that drive the markets. The Economic Calendar contains a full descriptions of the events and their relative importance in affecting the market, in addition to previous, forecast and actual figures as they're announced.

Display Time:Display time remaining until announcement [...] The highest-impact events include central bank interest rate decisions, Non-Farm Payrolls (NFP), GDP releases, the Consumer Price Index (CPI), and unemployment data. These are typically marked with three stars on the calendar because they can cause significant volatility across forex, equities, commodities, and bond markets. Filtering by high importance is a quick way to focus on the releases most likely to move prices.

## How to use Economic Calendar

Economic Calendar on TradingView shows the latest and upcoming economic events that can affect certain assets, regions, and global markets — for example, stocks, Forex, or bonds. [...] All events are in chronological order and linked with economic indicators like interest rates or GDP. The calendar is customizable: one click will give you a weekly economic calendar, another — narrow it down to US economic calendar only. Plus, you will see short explainers of the events and forecasts from experts. Just set your calendar and prepare for the next trade.

Learn more about the Economic Calendar features in our Help Center.
